svg.title: Electric panel with Battery Emulator, CAN-FD, HV bus and 12 V supply
svg.desc: Solar inverter connects to the HV bus through a 32 A DC MCB. The HV battery has an internal 350 A fuse and contactors. The DC/DC pre-charges the HV bus capacitor, 470 microfarad 450 volt. The 13.8 V AC/DC PSU is fed from mains through an AC MCB and powers the Battery Emulator, an ESP32-S3, and the HV battery BMS. The 12 V AGM battery plus has a 5 A fuse at the battery, then a cold-start switch, then a diode to the PSU 13.8 V rail, and its minus connects to PSU GND. A 100 A relay K1 in the DC/DC to AGM plus line is driven by a Battery Emulator output. CAN-FD links HV battery, Battery Emulator and DC/DC. RS485 links Battery Emulator and inverter. PE goes to the inverter case and HV battery case.
